subject.title: [Feature]: Add JSON-RPC bindings for language-agnostic plugins

question: Should OpenClaw accept a first-class manifest-declared stdio JSON-RPC plugin ABI for non-TypeScript plugin runtimes, and should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98005 be the supported v1 shape?
rationale: The request adds a new public plugin manifest/protocol surface and a child-process trust boundary, which automation cannot safely approve as product direction.

options.title: Review and sponsor the linked PR
options.body: Refresh and review the linked PR, then land it only if maintainers accept the ABI, lifecycle, permission, and support contract.

options.title: Narrow or gate protocol v1
options.body: Keep the issue open but ask the implementation to reduce the supported registration surface or mark the ABI experimental until support expectations are clearer.

options.title: Defer the core ABI
options.body: Leave the issue open or close it by explicit maintainer decision if the team is not ready to own language-neutral plugin runtimes in core.

recommendation.title: Review and sponsor the linked PR
recommendation.body: Refresh and review the linked PR, then land it only if maintainers accept the ABI, lifecycle, permission, and support contract.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa opened the feature issue and owns the current implementation candidate, making them the clearest first decision owner for the proposed ABI shape.
